title: What this site borrowed, and from when
caption: Ten things this site is made from, each with the year it came from and what it became here in October 2026. The oldest is a plugin from 1995. The newest is seven months old.
method: One row per thing borrowed: origin is the year (or year and month) it came from, null when I don't know it; via is a step between, where there was one; reused is when it landed in this repository; became is what it is here. A note marks what is my account only.
